title_zh: 先检查轮胎再决定是否更换

scenario.goal_zh: 说明轮胎漏气现象并约定检查后再决定修补或更换

context_zh: 韦斯已把汽车停在维修店外，轮胎反复漏气，他想先确认能否检查而不是直接购买新胎。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: My front tire keeps losing air overnight. The car is outside. Can someone check it today?

sentences.speaker: Garage Receptionist
sentences.text: We can inspect it at two this afternoon. Have you noticed any damage?

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: No, and I only bought it last month. Surely I don't need a new one already?

sentences.speaker: Garage Receptionist
sentences.text: We can't tell until we've examined it. We'll call you with the findings and a price before doing any repairs.

sentences.speaker: Wes
sentences.text: That's fine. Please book the inspection for two. I'll leave the keys with you.

sentences.speaker: Garage Receptionist
sentences.text: Thank you. I'll put it on the schedule and make sure the mechanic knows to call first.

targets.sense_zh: 表示相信某事应当如此并寻求认同
